reviews.shade: MENOKIN 30 Seconds Quick Bubble Mask Clear 95ml
reviews.text: After using this my face does feel refreshed, though I think the tackiness last longer than 30 seconds. So I normally leave it on about a minute or two before applying anything else. As someone with sensitive skin it did make me break out at first but my skin evened out after a week or two which is common with new products. Though other than adding extra moisture to my skin I haven't really experienced any other benefits.
reviews.zh: 用完之後，我嘅面確實感覺清爽，不過我覺得黏感好似持續多過30秒。所以我通常會等多一兩分鐘，先塗其他嘢。作為敏感肌膚，佢起初令我爆咗啲痘，但係一兩個禮拜之後皮膚就慢慢穩定落嚟，呢個係新產品常見嘅情況。不過，除咗為皮膚增加咗額外嘅水分之外，我冇真正感受到其他功效。

reviews.shade: MENOKIN 30 Seconds Quick Bubble Mask Clear 95ml
reviews.text: I discovered this product from makeup tutorials on rednote. Even though it’s technically a face mask, many makeup artists use it as a pre-makeup step. I bought it to try after seeing the tutorials, and it really works wonders. I’ll definitely repurchase. If your makeup tends to cake or flake, this is great for a quick fix, it makes your base so much smoother. The best part compared to sheet masks is that you don’t have to wait 15-20 mins or rinse it off. It comes out as a foam, and once you massage it in, it turns into a serum. It quickly gets your skin ready in no time. For me, it’s perfect as a pre-makeup base, hydrating but not greasy, and super time saving. My makeup goes on smoothly and flawlessly. Love it!
reviews.zh: 我喺小紅書（RedNote）嘅化妝教學影片入面發現呢款產品。雖然技術上係一款面膜，但好多化妝師都會用佢作為化妝前嘅步驟。我睇完教學之後買嚟試，效果真係好正。我一定會再買。如果你嘅粉底容易積粉或者浮粉，呢款就係快速解決方法，可以令底妝平滑好多。同面膜紙比較，最好嘅地方係，你唔使等十五至二十分鐘，亦唔使沖洗。佢以泡沫形式出嚟，按摩開之後就會變成精華。好快就令皮膚準備好。對我嚟講，佢係化妝前底妝嘅完美選擇，保濕但唔油，而且非常慳時間。我嘅妝容順滑又完美。好鍾意！

reviews.shade: MENOKIN 30 Seconds Quick Bubble Mask Clear 95ml
reviews.text:
Wanted to love it, but alas... It is great as a make-up base, however it's just too sticky on its own. Unfortunately I can't use it as a sleeping mask at night due to this. Even, if I use less than 2 pumps that are recommended on my face, it still feels like I have some tacky hair mousse residue there. At least, it doesn't have any discernable fragrance. 
It is somewhat moisturizing, but not overly so. It didn't cause any breakouts but also didn't cause any improvement on irritated skin. I think, there are better products for that on the market.
reviews.zh:
本來好想鍾意，但係好可惜……佢做化妝底好好，但係單獨用就太黏。可惜因為咁，我唔可以夜晚當睡眠面膜用。即使我用少過建議嘅兩泵，塗喺面上仍然覺得有啲好似黏咗定型慕絲咁嘅殘留物。至少，佢冇咩可以辨認嘅香味。
佢有啲保濕，但唔算特別強。佢冇令我爆痘，但都冇改善受刺激嘅皮膚。我覺得市面上有更好嘅產品可以處理呢方面。

reviews.shade: MENOKIN 30 Seconds Quick Bubble Mask Clear 95ml
reviews.text: This is a great replacement for sheet masks! This one is very soothing and makes my skin glow! Some nights I want the sheet mask experience without the hassle of doing it, and this is the perfect solution! I own every variety of this mask.
reviews.zh: 係面膜紙嘅絕佳替代品！呢款非常舒緩，令我嘅皮膚有光澤！有啲晚上我想要面膜紙嘅體驗，但唔想搞咁麻煩，呢款就係完美嘅解決方法！呢個系列嘅款式我全部都有。

reviews.shade: MENOKIN 30 Seconds Quick Bubble Mask Clear 95ml
reviews.text: It absolutely lives up to its 30-second promise! This bubble mask absorbs fast, leaving my skin healthy and radiant, and it applies so easily. It also makes makeup go on smoothly, giving my foundation a flawless finish. I love being able to layer different masks to customize the skin benefits to suit my specific needs.
reviews.zh: 絕對名副其實，兌現咗佢嗰30秒嘅承諾！呢款泡泡面膜吸收好快，令皮膚健康又有光彩，塗抹都好容易。佢亦令化妝順滑，令粉底效果完美無瑕。我好鍾意可以疊加唔同嘅面膜，按照自己特定嘅需要去定製皮膚功效。

reviews.shade: MENOKIN 30 Seconds Quick Bubble Mask Clear 95ml
reviews.text: My skin just loves these. I use this one on its own pretty regularly but when I’m having a rosacea flair up or after a more active treatment. I layer with the repair version and my skin feels soothed and repairs faster than on its own.
reviews.zh: 我嘅皮膚好喜歡呢啲產品。我通常都會單獨用呢款，但係當我酒糟性皮膚炎（玫瑰痤瘡）發作，或者做完較強效嘅護理之後，我就會同修護版本疊加使用。疊加之後，皮膚會更加舒緩，修復速度亦比單獨用快。

reviews.shade: MENOKIN 30 Seconds Quick Bubble Mask Clear 95ml
reviews.text: I understand why this is so popular as a makeup prep product. I did 4 small pumps around the face (chin, cheeks, and forehead) and it gave my skin a dewy look with a slightly tacky texture. It took a bit longer to rub in and set than expected (about 90 seconds) but still very quick. I don't think this did anything special to calm my skin, but it didn't irritate it. This seems like it has more temporary aesthetic benefits than actual skin health benefits.
reviews.zh: 我明白點解佢作為化妝前嘅產品咁受歡迎。我喺面上（下巴、面頰同前額）泵咗四小泵，佢令皮膚有啲露珠般嘅水潤感，質地有少少黏。推開同定妝所需嘅時間比預期長少少（大約九十秒），但仍然好快。我唔覺得佢對舒緩皮膚有特別效果，但係佢冇刺激皮膚。睇落佢比較似暫時嘅外觀效果，多過真正嘅皮膚健康功效。

reviews.shade: MENOKIN 30 Seconds Quick Bubble Mask Clear 95ml
reviews.text: I tried the bright version out of curiosity and came back for most of the line. This comes across as a gimmick but the foam is very easy to apply and so far the “masks” have done exactly what they say. They are a little tacky after application. This version was less so. I felt an instant soothing when using this one. I have healing acne that is drying out so that feels great. It is highly moisturizing. I would definitely layer this in the evening before bed for a more intensive treatment. My skin is dewy after use.
reviews.zh: 我出於好奇試咗亮白版本，之後就回頭買咗成系列大部分款式。呢款睇落似係噱頭，但泡沫好易塗，而家為止，呢啲「面膜」都做到佢哋所講嘅效果。塗咗之後會有少少黏，呢款就冇咁黏。我用呢款嗰陣即刻有舒緩感。我有啲正在癒合、乾燥中嘅痘痘，所以感覺好好。佢好保濕。我一定會晚上瞓覺前疊加使用，做更深層嘅護理。用完之後皮膚有露珠般嘅水潤感。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
